title: Glowing lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- glow halo -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='#ffcc44' opacity='0.18'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='26' fill='#ffcc44' opacity='0.25'/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d='M38 26 Q50 8 62 26' fill='none' stroke='#c98b2e' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- top cap -->
    <rect x='34' y='24' width='32' height='8' rx='3' fill='#e8a13a'/>
    <rect x='34' y='24' width='32' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f7c463'/>
    <!-- body frame -->
    <rect x='28' y='32' width='44' height='52' rx='9' fill='#ffcf4d'/>
    <!-- glass glow area -->
    <rect x='35' y='39' width='30' height='38' rx='6' fill='#fff3b0'/>
    <!-- inner flame -->
    <path d='M50 46 Q57 56 50 66 Q43 56 50 46 Z' fill='#ff8a1f'/>
    <path d='M50 53 Q54 59 50 65 Q46 59 50 53 Z' fill='#fff8d6'/>
    <!-- glass highlights -->
    <path d='M39 43 L39 72' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
    <!-- frame shade edges -->
    <rect x='28' y='32' width='6' height='52' rx='3' fill='#f0b53c'/>
    <rect x='66' y='32' width='6' height='52' rx='3' fill='#f0b53c'/>
    <!-- bottom cap -->
    <rect x='34' y='84' width='32' height='8' rx='3' fill='#e8a13a'/>
    <rect x='34' y='89' width='32' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd980'/>
    <!-- little feet -->
    <rect x='36' y='92' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c98b2e'/>
    <rect x='56' y='92' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c98b2e'/>
  </g>
</svg>
